question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word.**

They drank some __**spurious**__ drink and fainted.
solution:
The correct answer is "**genuine**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of the **highlighted word:**

 
 
• **Spurious**: 

 not being what it purports to be; false or fake. (जाली; नकली) 

 
 
• 
 **Example**: *The milk we bought from the roadside stall is **spurious**__.*
 
 
 
 
 
 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of the given **options:**
 __
 
• **genuine**: 
 truly what something is said to be; authentic. (वास्तविक)
 
 
• **curious**: 
 eager to know or learn something. (जिज्ञासु)
 
 
• **nefarious: **
 (typically of an action or activity) wicked or criminal. (दुष्ट)
 
 
• **artificial: **
 made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural. (कृत्रिम)

 
 
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**genuine**" is the antonym of "**spurious**".
 
 
• **Example**: *Nidhi is one of the most **genuine **__people I have met in a long time.*
 
 
 
• ​Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
